systems.system: National optical backbone (Central African Backbone project, Central African Republic component)
systems.country_label: dorsale optique nationale (Projet dorsale à fibre optique d'Afrique centrale)
systems.platform: 900 km of optical fibre, eleven technical sites and a network operations centre in Bangui
systems.owner: the project's coordination unit, from which the Agence centrafricaine de développement du digital derives; financed by the European Union (17 million euros), the African Development Fund (13 million) and the Transition Support Facility (4 million)
systems.tiers: installed at the project's close in September 2023, with links to Cameroon and Congo; communes are named only as places the fibre crosses

systems.owner: Central African Backbone project, financed by the African Development Bank
systems.tiers: one centre in Bangui, for 50 trainees

note: The African Development Bank's account of the fibre backbone project closed in September 2023; no local government office is said to be on the backbone, so it gives no fact.
